title: A Robot Walks into a Bar: Can Language Models Serve as Creativity Support Tools for Comedy? An Evaluation of LLMs’ Humour Alignment with Comedians
reasoning: The paper devotes substantial sections to evaluating global and community-based value alignment, examining how AI safety filters and ethical guardrails (moderation) conflict with creative expression and satire. It also interrogates the moral and social 'values' encoded within LLMs versus those of the artistic community.
